summary: Keeps Battle Shout up for its party. The raid's Battle Shout is off.
rotation: Start with 0 Rage. Bloodrage and Battle Shout at -3s, then Battle Stance, Charge (15 Rage) and back to Berserker Stance
Sunder Armor as the first GCD. Every warrior does this, and the tanks keep it up after
Recast Battle Shout with 35s left on it (about 142s in, before execute), unless its 3 min lasts the fight

Save Death Wish for the last 33s when that doesn't lose a use. Recklessness goes with the last Death Wish, and the trinket 1 GCD later. In fights with 2 Death Wishes, the first goes at the pull without Recklessness

Blood Fury and Berserking with Death Wish. Elune's Light on cooldown, but never during Recklessness or the 15s before it. Trinket on cooldown, with its last use saved for the last 30s. Mighty Rage Potion in the last 20s, and at the pull too when a second one fits
During execute, Execute comes first, before Bloodthirst and Whirlwind. That adds 4.1 DPS at 180s on the Phase 0 gear (it lost 4.7 on the synthetic gear's 12% hit)
Reckless Swings on cooldown, but only when no strike is ready, since it takes a 1s GCD. The next 4 swings give 5 more Rage each
Heroic Strike at 80+ Rage, or 60+ during Reckless Swings, during execute too, only when Bloodthirst and Whirlwind are 1s or more away
Hamstring as filler at 10+ Rage when Bloodthirst and Whirlwind are 1s or more away (it procs Windfury Totem and Flurry)
caveats: Assumed: white hits give Rage by weapon speed, at the level 30 rate even at level 60.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Heroic Strike stops at rank VIII, and the raid's Battle Shout at VI, Strength of Earth at IV and Grace of Air at II.
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is for white hits only. Heroic Strike can trigger Unbridled Wrath.
Only one +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 15.1 DPS.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece isn't counted. It would add 10.8 DPS vs Humanoids.
Saving Death Wish for the last 33s adds 13.3 DPS at 180s and 26.2 at 120s. Saving the trinket for the last 30s adds 2.2 at 180s.
Saving the second Mighty Rage Potion for the last 20s adds 10.4 DPS at 180s and 0.0 at 120s.
Rage from taking raid damage (2 hits a minute, about 9 Rage each) is an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec fury -gear level60_phase0_fury_dw -apl level60_fury_battle_shout -talents 30313113002-050530055120100231 -race Orc -duration 180, then the raid's battleShout removed (standards 23: the duty preset's own shout is the only one). The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull, and the preset's own pull Sunder is the raid's other one.8 / +1.8 / +1.0 at 120 / 180 / 300 s. Phase 0 gear since 2026-11-24 (the step 3 list, level60_phase0_fury_dw, Phase 0 step 4), was the synthetic level60_phase1_synthetic_fury_hit+2 (1097.2 at 180s). mksettings puts a Dense Weightstone on the main hand, since Ironfoe is a mace. Execute first in the execute phase since 2026-11-24 (tools/rotopt/warrior_presets.sh).
